title: Voxel Dozer Showcase
author: TinyPeopleProject
selftext:
I've always loved voxel games and felt that machinery interactions would be amazing so I've set out to test some ideas and landed on the voxel dozer as the first machine. Hope you enjoy, and happy to share any insights!

Features:

* Center of gravity
* Tread, smoke, and light effects (inertia driven smoke)
* Multiple digging and dumping heights
* Blade collision logic and pour logic
* Pour guide
* Transport mode

  
AI Usage:

* Debugging voxel optimization, engine stutters
* WebGPU optimization

  
LLM was incredibly powerful in processing gathered performance data, identifying issues, and suggesting fixes based on documented solutions in stack overflow, github, and other resources! I highy recommend setting up data capture and having an LLM comb through the results. Having an idea where problems may be occurring help guide the LLM but was only occasionally needed in testing.
